**q16.** Before deleting the memo row itself, the store layer deletes:
1. Memo relations (where memo is source: `memo_relation.memo_id`)
2. Memo relations (where memo is target: `memo_relation.related_memo_id`)
3. Attachments linked to the memo

Additionally, at the handler level (`memo_service.go:567-577`), comment memos (child memos related via COMMENT type) are recursively deleted first. And `memo_share` rows are cascade-deleted at the database level via `ON DELETE CASCADE`.

**q25.**
Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language) via `github.com/google/cel-go/cel`; engine lives at `internal/filter/engine.go` (`Engine` struct).
Mechanism: The CEL filter string is compiled into a dialect-agnostic IR condition tree (`internal/filter/parser.go`), then rendered into SQL WHERE clause fragments by a dialect-aware renderer (`internal/filter/render.go`). Each store driver calls `filter.AppendConditions()` with its dialect name (`DialectSQLite`, `DialectPostgres`, or `DialectMySQL`) to get dialect-specific SQL with proper placeholders, JSON extraction, and text-matching syntax.

**q26.** Tables affected when `DeleteMemo` runs:
`memo_relation` (explicit delete, both directions)
`attachment` (explicit delete of linked attachments)
`memo` (the memo row itself, and recursively for comment memos)
`memo_share` (database-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` from `memo_share.memo_id` FK)

**q27.**
Mechanism: Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) — the compiled React build is embedded into the Go binary at compile time, then served via Echo's static file middleware with an SPA fallback.
File: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (line 21 for the embed directive; line 54 for static middleware; wired at `server/server.go:72`)

**q28.**
`s3presign.Runner` — time.Ticker every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`; started in `server/server.go:162-169`)
Webhook async dispatch workers (4 goroutines) — channel-driven, started via `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:43-55`

Unused infrastructure: The `internal/scheduler` package contains a full cron-expression-based scheduler (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`) that is never imported or used by the server. The `server/runner/memopayload` package has a `Runner` struct with `RunOnce()` but it is only called inline (not as a background worker) — its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is used synchronously during memo create/update.

**q29.**
Interceptor path: `web/src/connect.ts` (frontend `authInterceptor`, line 156)
Token kinds: JWT access tokens (short-lived, 15 min), JWT refresh tokens (long-lived, 30 days, HttpOnly cookie `memos_refresh`), and Personal Access Tokens (PAT, SHA-256 hashed in DB)
Backend package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go` — `Authenticator` struct validates all three token types)

`memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
`memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`
`memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
`memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`

All defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. They all converge on `webhook.PostAsync()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which enqueues to `webhook.Post()` (line 120) for HTTP delivery.
